purpose: Non-normative historical reference inventory; normative text remains at the pinned revision.

method.source: git -c core.autocrlf=false -c core.eol=lf archive of the exact commit, with its frozen lockfile and historical builder. Source SHA-256 values are checked against raw Git blobs, not checkout-converted line endings.
method.words: Whitespace-separated tokens, including frontmatter and code, across published root Markdown pages.
method.rules: rule_definitions maps identified list-chip IDs to 1-based source lines; rule_references groups other lexical mentions, including examples, excluding each definition's own ID on its definition line.
method.links: Distinct href targets and h2/h3 IDs from each historical rendered article; inline_html retains entity/formatting spelling.
method.schemas: Exact $id values and every $ref with JSON Pointer location.
